name: Son of Monsterpalooza
blurb: The smaller autumn spinoff of Monsterpalooza, a makeup-effects and horror show at a Burbank hotel convention center.

editions.venue: The Marriott Burbank Convention Center & Hotel
editions.evidence: Eventbrite JSON-LD BusinessEvent "SON OF MONSTERPALOOZA - Burbank - 2026" 2026-10-09 -> 2026-10-11 at The Marriott Burbank Convention Center & Hotel; page text 'Friday, October 9-Sunday, October 11'; homepage ticket art is titled 'Tix - SoM26 - v3.jpg'.

notes: monsterpalooza.com/guests is a Squarespace page built from gallery blocks with no alt text or readable name strings - the extractor (even retried fresh with --channel msedge) only returns raw CSS block-id placeholders (e.g. '#block-c4f01e16...'), not the guest photos/names that are visually on the page. Guests is therefore 'unavailable' rather than guessed at. Dates/venue instead came from the linked Eventbrite listing, which has clean JSON-LD. No further edition beyond this Oct 2026 Burbank show is announced.
